people.name: Joseph
people.line: Husband of Mary and earthly father of Jesus

translations.web: Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife to himself;
translations.bsb: When Joseph woke up, he did as the angel of the Lord had commanded him and embraced Mary as his wife.
translations.kjv: Then Joseph being raised from sleep did as the angel of the Lord had bidden him, and took unto him his wife:
translations.asv: And Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took unto him his wife;
